usage: Iraqis rarely use a single word for "please". In shops and with strangers you will hear "min fadhlak" or "balla", and a request is often softened with "allah ykhalleek" (God keep you).

variants.label: everyday
variants.note: Polite please to a man; to a woman "min fadhlich".

variants.label: Iraqi
variants.note: Very Iraqi, softens any request: "balla, inteeni maay" (water, please).

variants.label: warm
variants.note: Friendly and heartfelt, used with friends and family.

examples.english: Excuse me please, where is the station?
